evidenceBoundary: Official-source design review and offline contract checks; no live database authentication, schema migration, workload activation or cleanup certification. Unsupported means this Hypervibe lifecycle is not implemented, not that the native product lacks jobs or PostgreSQL.

hosting.identity: Project, environment, source service, acknowledged temporary service and exact deployment; database volume and volume-instance are separate retained identities.
hosting.completionAndRecovery: Require the fixed correlated SQL or migration result and terminal exit, then exact temporary-service absence. Persist acknowledged identities and result before cleanup; unresolved creation or execution blocks replay.
hosting.prerequisites: Completed exact fresh-initialization receipt, approved immutable configured application image, selected database reference keys, private environment network and scoped image-pull access.
hosting.limitations: One private task proves only its own connection and reviewed command outcome. Application rollout, old-deployment drainage, schema correctness and restore readiness remain separate; no public proxy or CLI fallback.

hosting.identity: Cloud project, location, Job, Execution and individual Task are distinct resources.
hosting.completionAndRecovery: Native execution status and task outcomes must be correlated; cancellation retains the execution, while deletion removes its history. Restarting a job is another execution.
hosting.prerequisites: Reviewed image, job service identity, scoped execution permissions, secret access and appropriate VPC egress for a private database.
hosting.limitations: No fresh-generation bootstrap admission, finite SQL receipt or durable task-recovery implementation is registered. Existing runJob or Cloud SQL connectivity does not admit this lifecycle.

hosting.identity: AWS account, region, cluster ARN, task definition revision and returned task ARN.
hosting.completionAndRecovery: RunTask supports a clientToken tied to request parameters. DescribeTasks is eventually consistent and reports container exits; stopped task visibility is retained for at least one hour, not indefinitely.
hosting.prerequisites: Exact task and execution roles, immutable image, approved subnet/security groups and a separately admitted private database credential source.
hosting.limitations: No fresh-generation bootstrap admission or finite SQL/task recovery contract is implemented. An available RDS instance or RUNNING task cannot prove SQL authentication or migration completion.

hosting.identity: Full job ARM identity, Container Apps environment and returned execution identity.
hosting.completionAndRecovery: Manual jobs execute finite replicas with separate timeout, retry, parallelism and completion-count settings. Native retry behavior must not silently replay an uncertain migration.
hosting.prerequisites: Approved job image and identity, registry access, credential references and networking to the selected PostgreSQL server.
hosting.limitations: No fresh-generation receipt or resumable finite SQL/migration executor is registered. Shared environment networking alone does not establish database or command compatibility.

database.identity: Exact database service in its project/environment plus the newly acknowledged volume and volume-instance identities.
database.completionAndRecovery: PostgreSQL image initialization variables apply only to an empty data directory. A container's local trust connection does not prove the password; require a fresh private task connection and retained generation receipt.
database.prerequisites: Retained provider credential/reference sources and intended database/role; no existing-data replacement or password rotation is inferred.
database.limitations: Configured persistence and matching references are not SQL proof. Replacing storage invalidates earlier bootstrap completion; the future backup/restore gate remains in force.

database.identity: Cloud project, instance and region/connection name, selected database and database identity.
database.completionAndRecovery: Private Cloud Run connectivity requires the instance private IP and the appropriate VPC egress path. Instance state, connector IAM authorization and SQL login are different evidence.
database.prerequisites: Approved runtime identity and database user, Cloud SQL API/permissions, exact VPC route and connection mode.
database.limitations: Fresh-generation bootstrap is unsupported. No Railway variable interpolation, empty-volume semantics or public-IP fallback may be inferred.

database.identity: AWS account, region, DB instance identifier/ARN, endpoint and selected database/role.
database.completionAndRecovery: An available instance must also be network-accessible before SQL connection. A private instance requires VPC access; control-plane availability does not prove the supplied SQL password.
database.prerequisites: Approved task network/security groups, database authentication mode and endpoint/TLS configuration.
database.limitations: No fresh-generation bootstrap pair is implemented. Existing ECS task support is not migration or old-data backup-waiver authority.

database.identity: Flexible Server ARM id with subscription/resource group, selected database and role.
database.completionAndRecovery: Private access uses virtual network integration and DNS; another network needs the appropriate connectivity. Server readiness is separate from a fresh SQL connection and migration result.
database.prerequisites: Approved identity, database role, VNet/subnet/private DNS route and exact TLS configuration.
database.limitations: Fresh-generation receipt and bootstrap executor are unsupported. ARM authorization must not be treated as database login authority.
